target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft/v3 library including RawNode/Node, log, tracker, configuration and MemoryStorage. Embedding transport, durable medium and state machine are external interfaces; their in-library coordination remains in scope.
protocol_contexts: Node identity, election term, per-node role, ordered log index, applied voter configuration
Crash-fault assumptions with caller-compliant persistence and message production; no Byzantine fabricated messages
ownership: RawNode is thread-unsafe and serialized by caller; Node owns a channel-select loop.
Application owns storage persistence, state-machine execution, configuration application and transport.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader aggregates term-qualified persisted support; followers adopt bounded commitment.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Election, term dispatch and transfer establish or withdraw leader authority.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Snapshot catch-up and storage restart recover committed history and membership.
Applied configuration controls eligibility and joint-majority obligations.
Ready and completion accounting separate commit, issued application and completed application.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Library emits ordered persistence work; caller supplies durable storage; in-repository MemoryStorage and acknowledgment mechanics are implemented here.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Node/RawNode expose proposals and correlated read states; caller supplies ticks, transport, state machine and retries.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and active voter configuration
implementation_guards: Reject empty proposals, absent self membership, transfer-in-progress, or size excess.
Append responses require known Progress and pass term dispatch; quorum index must match current term to advance commitment.
writes: Appended term/index entries, per-peer Match and inflight state, monotone committed index
external_effects: Broadcast append on new commitment; release queued pre-current-term reads only in the successful MsgAppResp commit branch.
important_branches: Configuration proposals become empty normal entries when pending/unapplied or invalid joint phase, unless validation explicitly disabled.
Self append acknowledgment is deferred until storage completion.

behaviors.protocol_context: Local term, leader role and voter set
behaviors.trigger: Tick/campaign, vote replies, higher-term message, quorum check
implementation_guards: Campaign requires voter eligibility and no pending snapshot or unapplied committed configuration.
Vote requires voting eligibility in term and up-to-date candidate log; response aggregation uses configured voters and both joint majorities.
writes: Term, Vote, leader, state, election timers; reset votes, peer progress and readOnly on reset.
important_branches: Pre-vote does not increment term; real candidacy increments term and votes for self after durability.
Higher-term vote may be ignored during valid lease; higher-term pre-vote grant does not cause stepdown.
Old-term messages generally discarded; old append-storage response may still apply committed snapshot.
Leader acquisition appends current-term empty entry; prior committed log retained and inherited tail constrains new configuration proposals.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Resets support tracking across authority transitions; term matching prevents counting old-term append support as a new leader response.

unknowns: pendingReadIndexMessages survives reset while readOnly is replaced; exact cross-term pending-request consequences remain unexamined.

implementation_guards: Known non-learner transferee, not self; send TimeoutNow only when Match reaches last index.
important_branches: While transfer active, proposals are dropped.
Timeout clears leadTransferee if still leader. abortLeaderTransfer does not propose or invoke appliedTo.
Successful transfer enters ordinary election and authority transition.

cross_activity_effects.A4: An automatic configuration-exit proposal passes through the same proposal rejection while transfer is active.

unknowns: Whether application completion overlapping a failed transfer loses the only automatic exit trigger in a legal quiet history.

behaviors.protocol_context: Follower log under term-qualified leader message
implementation_guards: Append predecessor term/index must match; conflicting committed entry panics; append truncation cannot cross committed prefix.
writes: Unstable suffix, leader, election elapsed, committed index
external_effects: Append acknowledgment waits for storage; rejection carries index/term hints; heartbeat acknowledges context.
important_branches: Append commits at most received matching suffix end.
Heartbeat producer caps advertised commit at min(peer Match, leader commit).
Append below local commit acknowledges already committed position.

legal_preconditions: Apply accepted committed configuration in application order; retain ConfState for snapshots.
implementation_guards: Joint entry requires no existing outgoing configuration; simple change modifies at most one voter; resulting incoming voters nonempty; voters and learners cannot overlap.
writes: Incoming/outgoing voters, learners and staged learners, AutoLeave, Progress; pending transfer may be aborted on transferee removal.
important_branches: Entering joint preserves old voters; leaving joint clears outgoing and AutoLeave and finalizes learners.
switchToConfig may advance commitment under changed quorum, broadcasting append without calling releasePendingReadIndexMessages.
Removed/demoted leader optionally steps down; absent self blocks new proposals.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Config immediately determines whose Match contributes to commitment.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Config determines election votes, promotability and transfer eligibility.

unknowns: Can configuration-driven first current-term commitment leave pending reads without an implementation trigger? ReadIndex explicitly requires caller retries, so absence alone is not a completion violation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied index and current leader joint configuration
behaviors.trigger: Application acknowledgment or snapshot application completion
writes: May append empty ConfChangeV2 via ordinary proposal handling and set pendingConfIndex.
external_effects: Successful proposal replicates through ordinary append path.
important_branches: Zero payload bypasses size refusal but does not bypass leadership-transfer proposal rejection.
Rejection logs and returns; next application completion checks again.
Follower completion does not propose; subsequent elected leader empty-entry application can trigger retry.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Proposes the log entry whose application changes the dual-majority decision configuration.

unknowns: After transfer rejection and timeout with no additional committed entries, is another automatic invocation guaranteed by any caller duty or mechanism?

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode Ready/Advance and caller storage handler
behaviors.protocol_context: Ordered persistence batches and term-qualified storage completion
behaviors.trigger: Ready acquisition and subsequent persistence completion
legal_preconditions: Serialized RawNode access; persist and apply Ready work in documented order; do not mutate entries; AsyncStorageWrites local target queues are reliable and ordered.
durable_effects: Durability itself belongs to embedding caller; MemoryStorage is in-memory storage implementation.
external_effects: Return entries/HardState/snapshot and messages; route durability-dependent responses after storage.
important_branches: Synchronous Advance steps self responses and storage acknowledgments.
Asynchronous writes encode append/apply work as local messages; no Advance allowed.
Stale storage completion does not discard unstable entries; current-term storage completion after HardState term update can stabilize them.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Prevents publishing support before local persistence.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Persists term and vote and correlates unstable completion with current authority generation.

unknowns: Fine-grained asynchronous snapshot/application overlap remains unread beyond the completion handlers.

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode and raftLog, embedding state-machine caller
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed prefix with ordered application completion
behaviors.trigger: Ready.CommittedEntries or local apply work and completion
implementation_guards: Applied bounded by committed; applying cursor avoids redispatch; byte budget can pause application; snapshot in progress blocks committed-entry delivery.
important_branches: Application response is emitted only for nonempty committed entries; term zero permits completion after authority changes.
Snapshot completion separately calls appliedSnap then appliedTo.
Heartbeat-only Ready/Advance does not itself schedule appliedTo.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Application completion invokes automatic joint-exit test; configuration application itself occurs via caller ApplyConfChange.

implementation_guards: Reject obsolete snapshot; recipient must be present in configuration; restore only follower.
Matching snapshot term/index fast-forwards commitment rather than replacing log.
HardState commit must lie in retained log bounds.
writes: Restore committed prefix and unstable snapshot or reconstruct term, vote, applied cursor and configuration.
important_branches: Fresh construction reads Storage.InitialState and restores config with validation then enters follower.
Snapshot recovery rebuilds tracker and voter configuration; snapshot remains pending until storage/application acknowledgment.
Compacted replication uses recently active peer snapshot; unavailable snapshot returns for later retry.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot represents already committed prefix, not newly aggregated support.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovered configuration controls eligible participation; pending snapshot blocks campaigning.

behaviors.protocol_context: Application proposal/read request identified by context
legal_preconditions: Caller drives ticks, storage and message delivery; correlate reads with unique RequestCtx and apply through read index.
important_branches: Proposals have no guaranteed commitment.
ReadIndex may be lost without notice; interface assigns retry to caller.
Multivoter leader defers reads until current-term commitment, then obtains heartbeat-context quorum; reset replaces readOnly.
unknowns: Read retry progress and changed-configuration pending-read retention need separate applicability analysis.

facts.meaning: This instance has an active voter/learner configuration, optionally joint with AutoLeave selected.

identity.configuration: incoming/outgoing voters and learner sets installed by ordered ApplyConfChange or recovered ConfState

facts.validity_context: Until subsequent accepted configuration application or snapshot restoration; joint configuration with AutoLeave true selects automatic exit but does not assert that an exit proposal is queued.
facts.durability: ConfState is caller-recorded in snapshots; configuration entries are persisted in the log.
facts.recovery: confchange.Restore reconstructs incoming/outgoing groups and AutoLeave from stored ConfState.

facts.meaning: The node records a prefix as committed, eligible for ordered application subject to local storage and flow-control requirements.
facts.validity_context: Commitment is monotone across local term changes; leader advancement requires current-term quorum support, followers learn bounded commitment from matching append/heartbeat or snapshot.
facts.durability: HardState.Commit and snapshot/log state are persisted by caller.
facts.recovery: loadState validates stored commit within log; snapshot establishes committed index.

facts.meaning: The local raft instance has a role, term and known leader used to dispatch and qualify protocol messages.
facts.validity_context: Role/leader may change within a term; real elections increment term; lease/pre-vote rules qualify handling of future-term requests.
facts.durability: Term and vote in HardState; role and leader volatile.
facts.recovery: newRaft restores term/vote then becomes follower.

facts.meaning: The node has accounted for successful application through an index.
facts.validity_context: Committed prefix; completion remains meaningful after term changes and is distinct from Ready issuance.
facts.durability: Caller owns durable state-machine progress and supplies Config.Applied/recovered snapshot.
facts.recovery: newRaft initializes from compacted prefix and optional Config.Applied.

surfaces.reason: Can transfer rejection consume the last required automatic-exit trigger with no later application completion?
Does changed-quorum commitment leave pending requests behind, and what responsibility remains given the explicit caller retry contract?

formation.explanation: A1: a leader assigns term/index to proposals, appends unstable entries and replicates through peer Progress. Local and remote append support is published after persistence. Responses pass term dispatch and known-peer checks, update Match and contribute only through current configured voter majorities; joint commitment is the minimum of the two majority-supported indexes. maybeCommit advances only when that index has current term. Advancement broadcasts to followers; matching append constrains follower commit to received prefix, heartbeat producer caps it by peer Match, and committed conflicts cannot overwrite history. Ready exposes committed entries with applying cursor and size controls; caller applies configurations and state-machine entries, then completion updates applied. Rejected appends backtrack; heartbeat responses reopen flow and snapshots catch up compacted peers.

context.explanation: A2: eligible voters campaign only without unapplied committed configuration or pending snapshot. Real campaign increments term, records self vote durably and requests votes using last log term/index; configured majority votes acquire leadership. Pre-vote preserves local term until its quorum succeeds. Leader acquisition resets volatile support and appends a current-term empty entry. Higher terms normally step down with lease/pre-vote exceptions; old replies are discarded. Quorum loss can step down; transfer selects a caught-up voter, drops proposals while active and expires after electionTimeout if still leader. Restart restores HardState/configuration and enters follower. Existing committed decisions remain valid across authority changes; old storage snapshots and term-independent application completion remain consumable, while entry-stability acknowledgment requires matching generation.

connection.explanation: Applied membership determines support eligibility for both election and log commitment. Joint config requires both old and new majorities; recovery restores that same configuration, not a fresh quorum. Term reset clears votes and peer progress but retains committed history; log freshness and committed-prefix guards constrain subsequent formation. The new leader conservatively sets pendingConfIndex to inherited last index. Config proposals cannot overtake unapplied changes under normal validation. Automatic joint exit depends on application completion and leader role, and uses ordinary proposal admission, so an active transfer can reject it. Ordinary Ready completion only issues an apply acknowledgment for nonempty committed entries. readOnly support resets with authority, while pending pre-current-term reads have a distinct release path; their cross-context details remain open and their external API assigns retries to callers.

open_details: Automatic exit after failed transfer with no new application completion.
Configuration-driven pending-read release and pendingReadIndexMessages across terms; caller retries constrain obligations.
Fine-grained asynchronous snapshot/application overlap and resource-error recovery.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority, membership, persistence, rejection/retry, recovery and consumption paths are traced. Local questions remain; this map does not imply comprehensive safety or API coverage.
